basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences New Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Project Technical Support - I on a project-based engagement for a duration of 3 years under recruitment 2026. The qualification required for the post is 10th plus Diploma in MLT, DMLT or ITI, along with two years of experience in the relevant subject or field, and the pay is as per AIIMS and ICMR norms. Department of Onco-Haematopathology (डॉ. भी.रा.अ.सं.रो. कैंसर अस्पताल / DR. BRA-IRCH)
Identification of BCR::ABL1 Independent Resistance Mechanisms from Multi-omics Data of Indian CML Patients and Finding Novel Prognostic Markers Using AI/ML Techniques

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: 10th standard pass plus Diploma (MLT / DMLT / ITI) with two years of experience in the relevant subject or field. Desirable Qualification: Hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques such as DNA / RNA extraction.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support - I
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV and gather all supporting documents. Merge the CV and supporting documents into a single PDF file. Send the single PDF file by email to [email protected] . Ensure the subject line of the email mentions the name of the post (Project Technical Support - I) and project code (I - 1948). Submit the application on or before 25 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called in for the interview. No TA or DA will be provided for attending the interview.
